3135.title: Zones can arrange your cards
3135.one_line: Pick a row, a column or a grid and cards snap into place.
3135.visual_alt: Scattered cards snap into a grid inside a zone.
3135.agent_brief: Zones have a layout: Free, Row, Column or Grid. In Row, Column and Grid, cards keep their order and snap into place, and a card dropped into the zone joins at the end. Suggest it when the user tidies a board by hand or wants a kanban-style column. Set it with the layout button in the zone toolbar, or with agor_boards_update (layout: free, row, column or grid).

3182.title: See what's new in Agor
3182.one_line: The bell lists new features in each release, with a link to learn more.
3182.agent_brief: The bell in the navbar has a Release notes tab with the features in each Agor release; big launches appear once in a pop-up. Agents can read the same list with agor_feature_announcements_list, and recent ones appear as recent_agor_features in agor_sessions_get_current_context.
